propositions: CLI command identity and help are reconstructed through 19 overlapping frozensets, intercept ladders, and hand-maintained resources, causing parser/help drift and incomplete canonical help for 21 intercept-only commands

A single immutable lazy route registry must normalize every visible command, derive all syntax and options from side-effect-free argparse factories shared by execution and generation, and commit authoritative package-help bytes before operation/config/mount boundaries
Runtime help/overview and top-level unknown-command output must read only pre-generated bytes before any operation execution, handler resolution, or optional imports

Exact command aliases reuse canonical grammar; hidden commands are helpable but undiscoverable; historical spellings like jira-onboard and unknown commands like purge-bridge follow approved compatibility contracts
Lazy execution must preserve mount/init, argv, confirmation, stream, exit-code, and legacy-output contracts without eager optional imports or docs-only parser authorities
CLI reference generation, coverage checks, and lean-wheel validation must enumerate registries and parser artifacts instead of source regexes or manual command censuses
